items.mainDefect: The isAccessTokenId matcher reads the grant shortcut from the wrong position (substring(3,5) instead of substring(4,6)) and inverts the comparison, so the grant-type assertion never checks anything.

secondary.defect: The matcher has no length guard on items[0], so a prefix shorter than 5 chars makes substring(3,5) throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.

items.mainDefect: postInit calls the new abstract getShortcut() on every grant-type factory, so a custom grant provider built against an older Keycloak version throws AbstractMethodError and stops the server from starting.

secondary.defect: A factory that returns null from getShortcut() causes a NullPointerException in ConcurrentHashMap.put instead of a clear validation error.

items.mainDefect: getTokenContextFromTokenId requires the encoded context to be exactly 6 chars, but the SPI allows grant shortcuts of other lengths, so tokens from a custom grant with a 3-char shortcut can't be decoded.

secondary.defect: Token ids that contain a colon but have a prefix that isn't 6 chars long throw an exception instead of falling back to the UNKNOWN/legacy handling used for ids without a colon.
